evidence_summary: The West German Schaller fuzz lineage is now explicitly cross-indexed across Schaller and documented OEM/marketed identities including Kent, Höfner, Blackfield and Van Hall. These names are retained as product/marketing identities, not duplicate manufacturers. Kent 6400/6406 are treated as Schaller-associated states, with model-specific evidence preserved.

Dharma Sound is preserved as a historical marketed identity with a documented mid-1970s Sustainer and period advertisements for a small family of effects. Current evidence strongly associates parts of the range with the Sola Sound/Colorsound ecosystem, but does not justify treating Dharma Sound as an independent factory.

Futuristic Sounds is retained as a documented late-1970s marketed identity. The Sustain is historically linked to the same product family as Orange Sustain and Dharma Sound Sustainer, but the available evidence does not establish an independent manufacturer. Preserve the label and production relationship separately.

Orange Sustain is a documented 1970s English effect. Current evidence points toward a relationship with the same Sola Sound/Colorsound-associated sustainer family as Dharma Sound and Futuristic Sounds, so it is not promoted as a separate manufacturer here.

Van Hall is retained as a marketed identity associated with the Schaller Fuzz family. Existing evidence identifies Van Hall among Schaller-linked OEM/rebrand names; no separate factory attribution is promoted.
